description: The rules file's architecture section forbids domain importing infrastructure; the import in the diff is a deterministic finding before any model is asked, and the run posts it.
rules:
version: 1
architecture:
  layers:
    domain: ["src/domain/**"]
    infrastructure: ["src/infra/**"]
  edges:
    - from: domain
      to: infrastructure
      severity: critical
      note: Domain must not depend on infrastructure.
